question:
Find the part of the given sentence that has an error in it. If there is no error, choose 'No error'.

The most significant near - term impacts on renewable plants that are already contracted or under construction may being felt through supply chains.

options.text: renewable plants that are already contracted or under
The most significant near - term impacts on
construction may being felt through supply chains.

solution:
The correct answer is **Option 4)**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• In the** fourth part of the given sentence**, the incorrect form of the verb 'being' is used.
 
• The correct form should be 'be' instead of 'being'.
 
• Therefore, the corrected part should be 'construction may be felt through supply chains'.

Hence, the correct statement is **"*The most significant near-term impacts on renewable plants that are already contracted or under construction may be__ felt through supply chains."***

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• When constructing sentences, it is crucial to ensure that the correct form of verbs is used to maintain grammatical accuracy.
